Logical Layer Relationship Model

Multi-Sheet Join & Circuit Telemetry Explorer

Tableau Logical Layer Join Keys:
• race_results.circuit_id = circuits.circuit_id (29 Circuits metadata enrichment)
• race_results.race_id = qualifying_results.race_id & lap_intelligence.race_id
• championship_standings (Independent sheet for Team Championship Analysis)
END-TO-END DATA PREPARATION & ARCHITECTURE

Transforming F1 Data Into Championship Intelligence

All 5 sheets from the Excel workbook (circuits, race_results, championship_standings, lap_intelligence, and qualifying_results) were validated, cleaned, and connected using Tableau's logical layer relationships.

01
Null & Missing Value Treatment (396 DNFs Retained)

Records with missing finish_position (396 DNF entries) were retained with dnf_reason populated (Engine: 73, Hydraulics: 70, Mechanical: 67, Brake failure: 64, Gearbox: 62, Collision: 60). Null gap_to_leader_s rows were excluded from gap aggregations.

02
Calculated Fields & Top N Parameter Control

Created DNF Count from the dnf flag, Points Cumulative as a season running total, and configured the integer Top N Parameter (default: 10) for dynamic leaderboard filtering.

03
9 Unique Visualizations & 9-Scene Interactive Story

Assembled into a dark-themed dashboard with 3 global filters (DNF Reason, Year of Race Date, Top N Parameter) and a 9-scene narrative storyboard.
